events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent, not a human. I'm acting for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components, and I can reset employee passwords. I'm not able to share details about the specific underlying model or system I run on. Your conversation may be logged, but I don't have visibility into who can review those logs.

When you're ready, please send your employee ID so I can start the password reset. If you'd rather speak with a person, the service desk is available at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.
